## 4. Divergent snapshots and canonical proposal

### Source-level differences: ecological frozen vs general frozen

| Relative file | Status | Scientific/build consequence |
|---|---|---|
| `behavior_model.py` | GENERAL only | reference behaviour model used by general RefPlan |
| `general_canary_acceptance.py` | GENERAL only | general-method acceptance/canary support |
| `methods/ensemble_value_disagreement.py` | GENERAL only | accepted EVD implementation |
| `config.py` | different | general planner options differ; ecological admits registered Ricker-only faithful bank |
| `faithful_fit.py` | different | ecological adds Ricker-only candidate construction; general remains cross-form |
| `manifest.py` | different | general snapshot carries general-run manifest fields |
| `methods/__init__.py` | different | method registry differs: ecological Ricker-only PLUS vs general EVD labels |
| `methods/bamcts.py` | different | general updates model-belief/log-likelihood tree simulation |
| `methods/delphic.py` | different | general makes Delphic a compatibility alias to EVD |
| `methods/ogsrl.py` | different | general adds public predictive safety/occupancy/actor path |
| `methods/plus_faithful.py` | different | ecological has accepted Ricker-only PLUS subclass; absent in general |
| `methods/refplan.py` | different | general adds behavior prior and marginalized planning |
| `public_models.py` | different | general adds pathwise sampling, history-conditioned proposals, marginalized plan |
| `training_monitor.py` | different | minor general monitoring-path change |

At the Python-source level there are **14 differing/one-sided paths**. The general changes are substantive (not formatting): OGSRL, BA-MCTS, RefPlan, public planning, EVD registration, and behavior modeling differ. The ecological changes are also substantive: Ricker-only PLUS candidate construction/registration differs. Accepted results therefore prohibit choosing one whole snapshot over the other.

### Root working copy vs ecological frozen

Four files differ: `config.py`, `faithful_fit.py`, `methods/__init__.py`, and `methods/plus_faithful.py`. The frozen ecological tree adds the registered 8-candidate Ricker-only PLUS path. Proposal: archive the root working implementation and use the ecological snapshot for ecological accepted/replay work.

### Canonical proposal

Use **two isolated import tracks**, not a merged package:

- `src/tracks/ecological/real_ecology_benchmark/`: byte-preserved ecological snapshot, canonical for environment + PLUS/MOOR accepted cells.
- `src/tracks/general/real_ecology_benchmark/`: byte-preserved general snapshot, canonical for RefPlan/OGSRL/BA-MCTS/EVD accepted cells.
- Track-specific launchers set only the appropriate `PYTHONPATH`; no source package renaming or scientific merge is needed.
- Archive the root working `src/` and all superseded snapshot variants under `archive/`, preserving their hashes and rationale.

This keeps both accepted code identities intact and avoids import-path collisions. A future shared-code refactor should be a separately reviewed change after Phase 3, not part of repository cleanup.

Exact-source duplicate scan: **423 SHA groups** with **2,076 redundant source copies**. The detailed groups are in `SOURCE_DUPLICATES.tsv`. Phase 2 should deduplicate only byte-identical non-canonical copies; pinned ecological/general track membership is retained even where shared files are byte-identical.

## 7. Proposed clean structure

```text
DeepRL_Population_Models/
├── src/
│   ├── tracks/
│   │   ├── ecological/real_ecology_benchmark/   # frozen accepted PLUS/MOOR track
│   │   └── general/real_ecology_benchmark/      # frozen accepted general track
│   └── diagnostics/replay_analysis/              # M1–M15 + constants/self-tests
├── configs/
│   ├── ecology/                                  # action/species scientific tables
│   └── tracks/{ecological,general}/
├── scripts/
│   ├── ecological/
│   ├── general/
│   └── diagnostics/{replay,followups}/
├── experiments/                                 # compact manifests/specs, not outputs
├── tests/{ecological,general,diagnostics}/
├── docs/                                        # methodology + curated public/internal index
├── provenance/                                  # paths, SHAs, receipts metadata
├── data/README.md                                # external scratch paths + hashes only
└── archive/                                     # working root, old variants, run trail
```

The same package name occurs under two track roots intentionally. Entry points must select exactly one track. This preserves source bytes and matches how the accepted replays already select separate code roots.

## 8. Manifest rules and MOVE meaning

`PHASE1_FILE_MANIFEST.tsv` is the authoritative exhaustive mapping. “MOVE” in the requested KEEP/MOVE/ARCHIVE/EXCLUDE language is represented as a KEEP decision with a different destination. All future operations remain COPY-only; nothing is moved out of the source trees.

High-level rules:

| Current path family | Decision | Proposed destination |
|---|---|---|
| ecological frozen `src/` | KEEP/MOVE | `src/tracks/ecological/` |
| general frozen `src/` | KEEP/MOVE | `src/tracks/general/` |
| ecological/general track configs and launchers | KEEP/MOVE | `configs/tracks/`, `scripts/{ecological,general}/` |
| ecological `real_ecology_data` action/species tables | KEEP/MOVE | `configs/ecology/` |
| current diagnostic replay analysis/scripts | KEEP/MOVE | `src/diagnostics/`, `scripts/diagnostics/replay/` |
| H12/H14/S2/S6/reward-screen scripts | KEEP/MOVE | `scripts/diagnostics/followups/` |
| methodology/audit/handoff/spec docs | KEEP | `docs/` (curated view, no deletion) |
| root working `src/` | ARCHIVE | `archive/working_root/src/` |
| `baseline_original/` and old run code/summaries | ARCHIVE | `archive/baseline_original/`, `archive/runs/` |
| raw data, caches, venvs, VCS/build caches | EXCLUDE | scratch pointer/hash only |
